# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in any Finvix repository, please report
it privately. **Do not open a public issue.**

Use one of these two channels:

- **GitHub private vulnerability reporting** — the *Report a vulnerability* button on the
  Security tab of the affected repository.
- **Email** — <security@finvix.com>, with `[SECURITY]` at the start of the subject.

## What to include

The more precise the report, the faster it can be triaged:

- What the problem is, and what an attacker could do with it.
- How to reproduce it, step by step.
- Which component, service or endpoint is affected.
- A proof of concept, if you have one.

## What to expect

- We acknowledge every report we receive.
- We assess severity and impact, and tell you the outcome.
- We keep you informed while a fix is prepared.
- We will credit you if you want to be credited, once the issue is resolved.

Please give us a reasonable window to fix the issue before disclosing it publicly.

## Scope

This policy covers the repositories owned by this organization.
